securityContextSettings.title: Security Context
securityContextSettings.description: Configure your project's security context for CVSS 4.0 environmental scoring and vulnerability prioritization.

runtimeEnvironment.title: Runtime Environment
runtimeEnvironment.description: Configure the deployment environment and network topology of your project.

dataSensitivity.title: Data Sensitivity
dataSensitivity.description: Describe the type and sensitivity of data processed by this project.

businessContext.title: Business Context
businessContext.description: Define the business criticality and user impact of this project.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Select applicable regulatory and compliance frameworks.

environment.label: Environment
environment.tooltip: The deployment environment of your project. Production environments are scored more conservatively.

internetExposure.label: Internet Exposure
internetExposure.tooltip: How accessible your project is from the internet. Affects the Modified Attack Vector (MAV) in CVSS 4.0.

dataClassification.label: Data Classification
dataClassification.tooltip: The sensitivity level of data handled by this project. Affects Confidentiality Requirement (CR) in CVSS 4.0.

handlesPii.label: Handles PII
handlesPii.tooltip: Whether this project processes personally identifiable information (names, emails, addresses, etc.).

handlesPaymentData.label: Handles Payment Data
handlesPaymentData.tooltip: Whether this project processes payment card data or financial information.

businessCriticality.label: Business Criticality
businessCriticality.tooltip: How critical this project is to your business operations. Affects Integrity and Availability Requirements (IR/AR).

userBaseSize.label: User Base Size
userBaseSize.tooltip: The approximate number of users of this project. Affects Availability Requirement (AR).

complianceFrameworks.label: Compliance Frameworks
complianceFrameworks.tooltip: Regulatory and compliance frameworks this project must adhere to.

safetyCritical.label: Safety-Critical System
safetyCritical.tooltip: Whether this system could cause physical harm or safety risks if compromised (e.g. ICS/SCADA, medical devices, automotive). Enables CVSS 4.0 Safety scoring.

networkSegmentation.label: Network Segmentation
networkSegmentation.tooltip: The level of network segmentation around this project. Refines the Modified Attack Vector (MAV).

banner.title: Security context not configured
banner.description: Configure your project's security context to enable accurate CVSS environmental scoring and better vulnerability prioritization.
